findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock rose ~6% on these numbers in July, Handelsbanken and DNB Carnegie raised targets on them, and the stock now sits at 177 SEK with a flat 20-day run-up (+0.68%). What is not priced is only the size of the conversion; if the market expected more, the 60-day tape would not be -3.3%.

findings.why_not_priced: It is a public macro series and a proxy: macro-to-company transmission is not confirmed by OEM or a counterparty, and no Swedish industrial-distribution peer has reported Q3 yet. If the market had priced a strong Q3 on it, the stock would show a run-up into the print; it shows +0.57% over 5 days and +0.68% over 20. The same release flags input prices at 77.6, a margin headwind, which is why it stays small.
